title: Unit 3 第一课时 基础达标与综合拓展

sections.title: 一、语音练习
sections.instruction: 选出画线字母或字母组合发音不同的一项。

questions.prompt: 1. 选出画线字母发音不同的一项 ( )
questions.translation: 选出画线字母发音不同的一项。
questions.explanation: sport, short, fork中的画线字母组合or均在重读音节中发长元音 /ɔː/；而colour中的our在非重读音节中发弱读短元音 /ə/。故选 col<u>our</u>。

questions.prompt: 2. 选出画线字母发音不同的一项 ( )
questions.translation: 选出画线字母发音不同的一项。
questions.explanation: fox, clock, shot中的画线字母o在闭音节中均发短元音 /ɒ/；而colour中的字母o发短元音 /ʌ/。故选 c<u>o</u>lour。

questions.prompt: 3. 选出画线字母发音不同的一项 ( )
questions.translation: 选出画线字母发音不同的一项。
questions.explanation: fool, pool, moon中的画线字母组合oo均发长元音 /uː/；而look中的oo发短元音 /ʊ/。故选 l<u>oo</u>k。

questions.prompt: 4. 选出画线字母发音不同的一项 ( )
questions.translation: 选出画线字母发音不同的一项。
questions.explanation: lockers, clock, dog中的画线字母o在闭音节中均发短元音 /ɒ/；而notice中的字母o在重读开音节中发双元音 /əʊ/。故选 n<u>o</u>tice。

sections.title: 二、词形转换
sections.instruction: 根据要求写出下列单词的相应形式，从每小题所给的四个选项中选出正确的一项。

questions.prompt: 1. building (动词) ______
questions.translation: building的动词原形是______。
questions.explanation: 名词building（建筑物）对应的动词原形为build（建造，建筑）。故选 build。

questions.prompt: 2. across (动词) ______
questions.translation: across的动词形式是______。
questions.explanation: 介词across（横过，穿过）对应的动词原形为cross（穿过，跨过）。故选 cross。

questions.prompt: 3. important (名词) ______
questions.translation: important的名词形式是______。
questions.explanation: 形容词important（重要的）对应的名词形式为importance（重要性）。故选 importance。

questions.prompt: 4. locker (复数) ______
questions.translation: locker的复数形式是______。
questions.explanation: 可数名词locker（带锁的储物柜）的复数形式直接加s为lockers。故选 lockers。

questions.prompt: 5. in front of (反义词组) ______
questions.translation: in front of的反义词组是______。
questions.explanation: in front of意为“在……前面”，其反义词组为at the back of（在……后面/后部）。故选 at the back of。

questions.translation: art表示艺术家的名词形式是______。
questions.explanation: 名词art（艺术）后加后缀-ist构成表示人的名词artist（艺术家，画家）。故选 artist。

questions.prompt: 7. centre (形容词) ______
questions.translation: centre的形容词形式是______。
questions.explanation: 名词centre（中心）对应的形容词形式为central（中心的，中央的）。故选 central。

questions.prompt: 8. library (复数) ______
questions.translation: library的复数形式是______。
questions.explanation: 名词library以辅音字母加y结尾，变复数需变y为i再加es，即libraries。故选 libraries。

questions.prompt: 9. amazing (动词) ______
questions.translation: amazing的动词原形是______。
questions.explanation: 形容词amazing（令人惊叹的）对应的动词原形为amaze（使惊奇，使震惊）。故选 amaze。

questions.prompt: 10. interest (形容词) ______
questions.translation: interest的形容词形式是______。
questions.explanation: interest的形容词形式有interested（感兴趣的，主语通常为人）和interesting（有趣的，主语通常为物）。故选 interested / interesting。

sections.title: 三、根据句意或汉语提示完成句子
sections.instruction: 根据汉语提示与句意，从每小题所给的四个选项中选出最佳选项。

questions.prompt: 1. The ______ (礼堂) is too small to hold so many people.
questions.translation: 礼堂太小了，容纳不下这么多人。
questions.explanation: 名词hall意为“大厅，礼堂”。故选 hall。

questions.prompt: 2. It's time to have lunch. Let's go to the ______ hall.
questions.translation: 该吃午饭了。我们去餐厅吧。
questions.explanation: dining hall为固定词组，意为“餐厅，食堂”。故选 dining。

questions.prompt: 3. You can see lots of new ______ (建筑) on this street.
questions.translation: 在这条街上你可以看到很多新建筑。
questions.explanation: lots of后接可数名词复数，building的复数形式为buildings。故选 buildings。

questions.prompt: 4. Look! Butterflies are flying around the ______ (田地).
questions.translation: 看！蝴蝶正在田野周围飞舞。
questions.explanation: 名词field意为“田地，田野；场地”。故选 field。

questions.prompt: 5. These kind postmen work in that post ______.
questions.translation: 这些热心的邮递员在那家邮局工作。
questions.explanation: post office为固定短语，意为“邮局”。故选 office。

questions.prompt: 6. Cindy goes to the English ______ (角) once a week.
questions.translation: 辛迪每周去一次英语角。
questions.explanation: English corner为固定表达，意为“英语角”。故选 corner。

questions.prompt: 7. I work out at the ______ (健身房) most days.
questions.translation: 我大多数日子都在健身房锻炼。
questions.explanation: 名词gym意为“健身房，体育馆”。故选 gym。

questions.prompt: 8. Can you see the cat? It's ______ (在……后面) the door.
questions.translation: 你能看见那只猫吗？它在门后面。
questions.explanation: 介词behind意为“在……后面”。故选 behind。

questions.prompt: 9. There is a ______ (图书馆) in our school and there are a lot of books in it.
questions.translation: 我们学校有一座图书馆，里面有很多书。
questions.explanation: 名词library意为“图书馆”。冠词a后接单数名词library。故选 library。

sections.title: 四、用所给词的适当形式填空
sections.instruction: 根据句子语法与句意，从每小题所给的四个选项中选出正确的一项。

questions.prompt: 1. It took them two years ______ (build) the house.
questions.translation: 建这座房子花了他两年的时间。
questions.explanation: It takes/took sb. some time to do sth. 为固定句型，it作形式主语，真正主语用动词不定式to build。故选 to build。

questions.prompt: 2. If a person ______ (cross) the river, he will see a different beauty.
questions.translation: 如果一个人过河，他会看到别样的美丽。
questions.explanation: if引导的条件状语从句遵循“主将从现”原则，主语a person为第三人称单数，动词用三单形式crosses。故选 crosses。

questions.prompt: 3. Students put up important ______ (notice) on the board.
questions.translation: 学生们在黑板上张贴重要的通告。
questions.explanation: notice作为“通告，通知”是可数名词，此处表示复数概念用notices。故选 notices。

questions.prompt: 4. The teachers' building is behind the ______ (sport) field.
questions.translation: 教师楼在运动场后面。
questions.explanation: sports field为固定复合名词词组，意为“运动场，操场”。故选 sports。

questions.prompt: 5. Ella always ______ (put) up her hands when the teacher asks someone to answer questions.
questions.translation: 当老师叫人回答问题时，埃拉总是举起手。
questions.explanation: 根据频度副词always可知句子用一般现在时，主语Ella为第三人称单数，动词put用三单形式puts。故选 puts。

questions.prompt: 6. There ______ (be) also salad, hamburgers, fish and drinks on the table.
questions.translation: 桌子上还有沙拉、汉堡、鱼和饮料。
questions.explanation: there be句型遵循“就近原则”，紧随其后的名词salad为不可数名词，be动词用单数is。故选 is。

questions.prompt: 7. It's exciting ______ (meet) new classmates at school.
questions.translation: 在学校认识新同学是令人兴奋的。
questions.explanation: It is + adj. + to do sth. 为固定句型，it作形式主语，真正的主语为动词不定式to meet。故选 to meet。

questions.prompt: 8. At weekends, I often do some ______ (clean).
questions.translation: 在周末，我经常做大扫除。
questions.explanation: do some cleaning为固定搭配，意为“打扫卫生，做清洁”。故选 cleaning。

questions.prompt: 9. My parents bought me a lot of ______ (help) books on maths to support my studies.
questions.translation: 我父母给我买了很多有用的数学书来支持我的学习。
questions.explanation: 修饰名词books需要用形容词helpful（有帮助的，有用的）。故选 helpful。

sections.title: 五、连词成句
sections.instruction: 将所给词语连成一句话，注意大小写和标点符号。

questions.prompt: whiteboard, is, to, a, there, blackboard, next, the, smart (.)
questions.answer: There is a smart whiteboard next to the blackboard.
accept: There is a smart whiteboard next to the blackboard.
There is a blackboard next to the smart whiteboard.
questions.translation: 黑板旁边有一块智能白板。
questions.explanation: there be句型：There is + a smart whiteboard + next to + the blackboard，句末用句号。

questions.prompt: any, classroom, there, lockers, in, the, are (?)
questions.answer: Are there any lockers in the classroom?
questions.translation: 教室里有储物柜吗？
questions.explanation: there be句型的一般疑问句：Are there + any lockers + in the classroom? 句首首字母大写，句末用问号。

questions.prompt: is, desk, where, teacher's, the (?)
questions.translation: 讲台（老师的桌子）在哪里？
questions.explanation: 特殊疑问句：Where + is + the teacher's desk? 句首首字母大写，句末用问号。

questions.prompt: our, drawers, the, desk, put, we, things, in (.)
questions.answer: We put our things in the desk drawers.
questions.translation: 我们把我们的物品放在课桌抽屉里。
questions.explanation: 陈述句：主语“We” + 谓语“put” + 宾语“our things” + 介词短语“in the desk drawers”，句末用句号。

questions.prompt: in, what, classroom, special, his, is (?)
questions.answer: What is special in his classroom?
questions.translation: 他的教室里有什么特别之处？
questions.explanation: 特殊疑问句：What + is + special + in his classroom? 句首首字母大写，句末用问号。

questions.prompt: some, milk, the, is, bottle, in, there (.)
questions.answer: There is some milk in the bottle.
questions.translation: 瓶子里有一些牛奶。
questions.explanation: there be句型：There is + some milk + in the bottle，句末用句号。

sections.title: 六、完形填空
sections.instruction: 通读短文，从每小题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
Would you like to have a class by the sea? It [1] like a dream, right? Well, a school in Spain makes this dream come true for its students, by moving the [2] to the beach!

Outside the school, children have classes on the [3]. The lessons are part of a plan called "Fresh Air". It is to [4] kids to get better air between classes.

Learning on the beach is [5] from the traditional class. Many students enjoy staying on the beach. "I feel very [6] and relaxed here," says one of the students. "We can learn and [7] ourselves in every class." Of course, the teachers always look after the students [8] and well. They make sure that all the kids are safe. "The children are having great fun," says an English teacher. "I think they won't forget what they have learnt here."

A class by the sea is not just a [9] to the beach. Some fishermen show the students their fishing nets. They also teach the students how to catch fish. Children can learn well and play happily in this [10] nature classroom! It is an amazing experience for them.

questions.translation: 这听起来像个梦想，对吧？
questions.explanation: sound like为固定短语，意为“听起来像……”。主语It为第三人称单数，用sounds。故选 sounds。

questions.translation: 西班牙的一所学校把课堂/教室搬到了海滩上……
questions.explanation: 根据上下文可知是把教室/课堂搬到海滩上（moving the classroom to the beach）。故选 classroom。

questions.translation: 在校外，孩子们在沙滩上上课。
questions.explanation: 在海滩（beach）上上课，对应的即在沙滩（sand）上。故选 sand。

questions.translation: 这是为了帮助孩子们在课间获得更好的新鲜空气。
questions.explanation: help sb. to do sth. 为固定搭配，意为“帮助某人做某事”。故选 help。

questions.translation: 在海滩上学习与传统课堂截然不同。
questions.explanation: be different from为固定短语，意为“与……不同”。故选 different。

questions.translation: 我在这里感到非常快乐和放松……
questions.explanation: 与relaxed（放松的）并列且符合学生喜欢海滩的情感，选用happy（快乐的）。故选 happy。

questions.translation: 我们可以在每堂课中学习并享受其中（玩得开心）。
questions.explanation: enjoy oneself为固定短语，意为“玩得开心，过得愉快”。故选 enjoy。

questions.translation: 当然，老师们总是细心、周到地照顾学生们。
questions.explanation: 修饰look after（照看，照顾）应用副词carefully（细心地，周密地）。故选 carefully。

questions.translation: 海边的一堂课不仅仅是一次去海滩的旅行。
questions.explanation: a trip to the beach意为“去海滩的旅行”。故选 trip。

questions.translation: 孩子们可以在这个绝佳的大自然教室里好好学习、快乐玩耍！
questions.explanation: 修饰nature classroom且表示积极赞扬，用great（极好的，绝妙的）。故选 great。

sections.title: 七、阅读理解
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，从每小题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
Going to a new school can be difficult. Here is something to help you to fit in (融入).

First, take a day to enjoy your school. You won't fit in if you don't know the school. Ask for a school map. To make it easy, ask the people near you or an old student.

Be nice to everyone. Be nice to everyone, because they may just be your next teachers or friends. Listen carefully in the class.

You need to make friends. Talk to different people. Join a few clubs and make more friends in this way.

Be yourself and be polite. Don't be worried too much about others' opinions (意见) on you. Don't be afraid to stand up for yourself if you are right.

Work hard to fit in while still being yourself. The first few weeks are always hard, but you'll soon get used to (习惯) it.

questions.prompt: 1. Why should we be nice to everyone?
options: Because they may be your schoolmates.
Because they may be your teachers or friends.
Because they may be workers in school.
questions.translation: 为什么我们应该对每个人都很友善？
questions.explanation: 根据第三段中的“Be nice to everyone, because they may just be your next teachers or friends.”可知，因为他们可能会成为你的老师或朋友。故选 Because they may be your teachers or friends.。

questions.prompt: 2. What does the underlined phrase "<u>stand up for yourself</u>" mean?
options: Try to stand up all the time.
questions.translation: 画线短语“stand up for yourself”是什么意思？
questions.explanation: 根据前文“Don't be afraid to stand up for yourself if you are right.”可知，如果你是对的，就不要害怕坚持自己的观点/为自己发声（Not changes your idea）。故选 Not changes your idea.。

questions.prompt: 3. What can we know from the passage?
options: Teachers in a new school usually ask you to listen carefully.
You should talk to other students in a different way.
It is very easy to get used to the new school.
Joining a club can make you know more friends.
questions.translation: 我们能从文章中了解到什么？
questions.explanation: 根据第四段中的“Join a few clubs and make more friends in this way.”可知，加入社团能让你结交更多的朋友。故选 Joining a club can make you know more friends.。

questions.prompt: 4. What's the passage mainly about?
options: How to fit in at a new school.
How to make friends at a new school.
How to be a member of your new school.
How to be yourself at a new school.
questions.translation: 这篇文章主要讲了什么？
questions.explanation: 根据第一段“Here is something to help you to fit in.”及全文提出的各项融入新学校的建议可知，文章主旨是如何融入新学校。故选 How to fit in at a new school.。

sections.title: 八、语篇填空
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，从每小题所给的四个选项中选出最佳选项填入空白处，使短文通顺完整。
sections.passage:
Mr. Smith is our school gardener. He is [1] old man with a head of white hair. He works hard [2] (make) our school green and lively. No matter in the winter cold or in the summer heat, he is never late [3] work. He goes to work early in the morning and only leaves in the evening.

Every day, he [4] (wear) a grey hat and a pair of blue trousers. He cleans the leaves in the garden three [5] (time) a day. He also plants trees and waters flowers. When he is working, he is very serious. He even gets angry when we try to talk to [6] (he). He is always quiet during his working time. [7], he becomes a different person after finishing all the work. He will talk to us about his family and friends [8] (happy). He always puts a smile on our faces, just like our dear grandfather.

Mr. Smith makes our school more beautiful than before [9] we are glad to have such a school gardener. He is loved by everyone [10] our school.

questions.translation: 他是一位满头白发的老人。
questions.explanation: old以元音音素开头，表示“一位”不定冠词用an。故选 an。

questions.prompt: 2. (make) ( )
questions.translation: 他努力工作，让我们的学校变得绿意盎然、生机勃勃。
questions.explanation: 此处用动词不定式to make作目的状语，表示努力工作的目的。故选 to make。

questions.translation: 他上班从不迟到。
questions.explanation: be late for为固定短语，意为“迟到”。故选 for。

questions.prompt: 4. (wear) ( )
questions.translation: 每天，他都戴着一顶灰色的帽子，穿着一条蓝色的裤子。
questions.explanation: 根据Every day可知用一般现在时，主语he为第三人称单数，谓语动词wear需用三单形式wears。故选 wears。

questions.prompt: 5. (time) ( )
questions.translation: 他一天打扫三次花园里的落叶。
questions.explanation: 基数词three后接表示“次数”的可数名词复数times，three times a day意为“一天三次”。故选 times。

questions.translation: 当我们试图和他说话时，他甚至会生气。
questions.explanation: 介词to后接人称代词宾格him。故选 him。

questions.translation: 然而，在完成所有工作之后，他就变成了另一个人。
questions.explanation: 前文提到工作时严肃安静，后文提到下班后热情开朗，前后句构成转折关系，副词However符合语境。句首首字母大写。故选 However。

questions.prompt: 8. (happy) ( )
questions.translation: 他会开心地跟我们谈论他的家人和朋友。
questions.explanation: 修饰动词talk需用副词happily（开心地）。故选 happily。

questions.translation: 史密斯先生让我们的学校比以前更加美丽，我们很高兴有这样一位校园园丁。
questions.explanation: 前后两个分句为并列承接关系，连词用and。故选 and。

questions.translation: 他受到我们学校每个人的喜爱。
questions.explanation: 表示在学校里，介词用in，in our school意为“在我们学校”。故选 in。

sections.title: 九、阅读与表达 (任务型阅读)
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，从每小题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
Hello, my name is John. I am going to show you around my hometown. Here is my house. I live in a small house. We have a small garden. My mother grows vegetables and flowers in the garden.

Outside the garden is a bus stop. It takes about twenty minutes to get to the nearest town by bus. There are lots of buildings in the town. There is a shopping mall, a youth centre and a cinema. There is a park near the centre of the town. My favourite place is the youth centre. I often go there with my friends after school. We can do many things there. I like going there on my bicycle. I have many friends in my hometown. I think it's a wonderful (绝妙的) place to live. I hope you can come and visit my hometown soon.

questions.prompt: 1. What does John's mother grow in the garden?
options: She grows vegetables and flowers in the garden.
She grows nothing in the garden.
questions.translation: 约翰的妈妈在花园里种了什么？
questions.explanation: 根据第一段中的“My mother grows vegetables and flowers in the garden.”可知，她在花园里种蔬菜和花。故选 She grows vegetables and flowers in the garden.。

questions.prompt: 2. Where is the bus stop?
options: It is in front of the school.
It is near the shopping mall.
It is next to the youth centre.
questions.translation: 公共汽车站在哪里？
questions.explanation: 根据第二段第一句“Outside the garden is a bus stop.”可知，公交车站在花园外面。故选 It is outside the garden.。

questions.prompt: 3. How long does it take John to get to the nearest town by bus?
questions.translation: 约翰乘公交车去最近的城镇需要多长时间？
questions.explanation: 根据第二段第二句“It takes about twenty minutes to get to the nearest town by bus.”可知大约需要20分钟。故选 About 20 minutes.。

questions.prompt: 4. What place is John's favourite in the town?
questions.translation: 镇上约翰最喜欢的地方是哪里？
questions.explanation: 根据第二段中的“My favourite place is the youth centre.”可知最喜欢的地方是青年活动中心。故选 The youth centre.。

questions.prompt: 5. How does John go to the youth centre?
options: He goes to the youth centre by bicycle.
questions.translation: 约翰怎样去青年中心？
questions.explanation: 根据第二段中的“I like going there on my bicycle.”可知他是骑自行车去的。故选 He goes to the youth centre by bicycle.。

sections.title: 十、真题演练 (还原短文)
sections.instruction: 阅读下面短文，从框内 6 个选项中选出能填入空白处的最佳选项。选项中有一项为多余选项。
sections.passage:
How do you celebrate your birthday? With a cake, a party for your friends and family? In some countries, birthday celebrations are really unusual.

In China, a birthday child usually eats very long noodles with eggs. People never cut up the noodles [1] they are a symbol of long life, and eggs mean good luck.

In some parts of India, when a child has their first birthday, their parents cut off all their hair. The child wears colorful clothes [2] gives chocolate to their friends.

In Korea, they celebrate day number 100 [3] the child is born. Families make sure a birthday child gets many rice cakes with honey. When [4] child gets 100 rice cakes, this means they will live a happy and long life.

When children in Denmark wake up [5] their birthday, they find gifts all around their beds. That's why some of the children are so excited that they cannot fall asleep the night before!

questions.translation: 人们从不切断面条，因为它们象征着长寿……
questions.explanation: 后句解释不切断面条的原因，从属连词用because（因为）。故选 because。

questions.translation: 孩子穿着色彩鲜艳的衣服，并给朋友们分发巧克力。
questions.explanation: wears colorful clothes与gives chocolate为并列动作，连词用and。故选 and。

questions.translation: 在韩国，他们在孩子出生100天后进行庆祝。
questions.explanation: after the child is born意为“在孩子出生之后”，介词/连词用after。故选 after。

questions.translation: 当一个孩子得到100个米糕时……
questions.explanation: child为单数可数名词，泛指“一个孩子”用不定冠词a。故选 a。

questions.translation: 当丹麦的孩子们在生日那天醒来时……
questions.explanation: 具体某一天用介词on，on their birthday意为“在他们的生日那天”。故选 on。
